about: The stream title rule (ADR-005 S4d / S4e), one table for both implementations: core's StreamService.TitleIsAuto / TypedTitleWins (tests/test_stream_service.py) and the Stream page's titleIsAuto / typedTitleWins (web/src/StreamPage/titleRule.ts, its jest test). Change a case here and both have to agree.

titleIsAuto.title: Mine
titleIsAuto.why: typed by hand before any auto title

titleIsAuto.title: Anything
titleIsAuto.why: a state from before titleAuto: its title counts as auto

typedTitleWins.title: Cup
typedTitleWins.why: typed over the auto title it started from

typedTitleWins.title: Mine
typedTitleWins.why: typed over a title of the operator's own

typedTitleWins.title: Cup ft. Ada
typedTitleWins.why: an auto title landed while the operator typed: the typing wins

typedTitleWins.title: Cup
typedTitleWins.why: an auto title landed in a field that was empty

typedTitleWins.title: Web's
typedTitleWins.why: another writer's own title landed meanwhile: that one wins

typedTitleWins.title: Cup ft. Ada
typedTitleWins.why: nothing typed: the field merely kept an old value, never written back over the newer one

typedTitleWins.title: Mine
typedTitleWins.why: cleared by hand: written (core makes the next auto title)

typedTitleWins.title: Web's
typedTitleWins.why: no titleAuto yet: the state's title counts as auto
